title: DeepSeek Web Tools: common Chat Completions request fields
description: Guide checked 2026-11-18 against https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/create-chat-completion/ and https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/web_tools/. Not a complete upstream schema. Additional fields are passed through; upstream validation is authoritative.

model.description: The official Web Tools guide currently specifies deepseek-flash.

server_tool_calls.description: Pass prior assistant server_tool_calls back unchanged, including signatures.

tools.description: Declare deepseek_web_search, deepseek_read_url, or both. The server decides whether to use them; each web tool may appear only once. Other officially supported tool fields can pass through, but this script does not execute client-side tools.

thinking.description: Overrides reasoning_effort for selecting thinking versus non-thinking. If both are omitted, thinking is enabled.

reasoning_effort.description: Native values are none/low/high/max; the API also accepts minimal as low, and medium/xhigh as high. Default effort is high.

stream.description: This CLI supports non-streaming responses only; may be omitted.

tool_choice.description: auto leaves the decision to the model; none disables tools. With web tools, required is treated as auto. A web tool cannot be forced by name.

messages.content: What changed in the latest DeepSeek API release? Check official sources.
Compare the latest DeepSeek web tools and standalone Search/Fetch APIs using official documentation.
Read https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/web_tools/ and explain how URL reading is enabled.
